counterfactual.change: Set initial.v from 0.3066850961783899 to 0.0 (single field) – removing initial forward momentum. Same steps (261) and all other parameters identical; scenario then stays inside track, proving drift due to unchecked initial velocity integration causes cart_in_track violation.

explanation: Shrunk scenario has no pushes and zero sensor noise. Cart starts offset +0.43m with forward velocity +0.31 m/s. Controller keeps pole upright (theta ~0.08 rad, well within 0.8) with small force ~0.87N << 65N limit, but never reverses cart drift. Energy and work remain bounded. Velocity grows monotonically to ~1.37 m/s, so position drifts from x=0.43 to x=2.40 and exceeds track limit at final step. Cause is position-non-regulating state-feedback: controller stabilizes angle but allows steady position integration to violate track. Counterfactual zeroing initial v removes the initial momentum and keeps cart inside track for same horizon.

violation.detail: cart at x=2.404 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: Across frames 258 to 261 the blue cart drifts steadily rightward along the track while the pole remains nearly upright and stable. At step 261 the cart reaches and exceeds the right track limit, shown highlighted in red, even though the pole shows no sign of falling.
